purpose: Static PixelLab input candidates for later whole-fire composition; no animation generated here.

24.alpha_mask: 8-connected medium stroke dilated by 3 native pixels, intersected with original nonzero alpha; foreign cores excluded and shared halo assigned to nearest own core
24.overlap_resolution: Foreign cores removed from halos; shared non-core halo pixels assigned by minimum Euclidean distance to each candidate group own core (key tie-break). Residual cores remain on static original plate.
24.overview_legend: green=covered by one static alpha group; pink=overlapping static groups; yellow=uncovered threshold core; numbered groups are individual inputs
24.caveat: Threshold core coverage measures selected source light strokes, not animated coverage or artistic acceptance. Diffuse red heat outside the core stays on the original static tile.

29.core_threshold: R>205 and G>95 and B<110 and R-G>75
